name: hbplus-portal
description: Cross-platform HB+ Team Portal built with React Native, Expo, and React Native Web, featuring Google OAuth authentication, Supabase integration, and secure access restricted to verified @hbplus.fit email accounts.

paragraphs: A cross-platform (web, Android, iOS) React Native app with Google sign-in restricted to hbplus.fit email accounts. One shared codebase built with Expo, Expo Router, React Native for Web, TypeScript and Supabase Auth.

Verification status (read this first). Verified locally: type checking, lint, 137 Jest tests, a production web build, Android/iOS bundle compilation and generated native config, and the SQL migration on PostgreSQL 16. Not verified: a real Google sign-in against a live Supabase project, a deployed Netlify site, and running on an Android/iOS emulator or device. Those need your credentials or hardware; exact steps are below. See Known limitations for what the tests can and cannot prove.
